title: Owner-authorized track delete lifecycle
purpose: Expose owner-authorized private track deletion through the canonical track operation service now that revision-gated track deletion exists.
deleteOrder: Validate canonical project and track identifiers.
Reload and recheck the canonical project snapshot.
Require the track id to be attached to project.trackIds.
Load the canonical track snapshot and require its projectId to match.
Detach the track id from project.trackIds through project compare-and-swap.
Delete track metadata through deleteTrackConditionally using the previously read track revision.

concurrency.staleTrackAfterDetach: fail unavailable and surface orphan cleanup risk

partialFailure.rule: Do not silently reattach a track after the project detach has succeeded and metadata deletion has been attempted.
partialFailure.reason: After a destructive persistence attempt, outcome may be ambiguous; automatic reattachment could create a dangling project reference.

audioBehavior.trackAudioAssetIds: Track deletion removes only the organizational track record.

boundaries: No R2 or audio-byte authority is added.
No audio asset metadata is deleted.
No public media authority is added.
No copyright, publishing, master, management, licensing, or royalty semantics are added.
